MDG.note: Nothing on rules or an authority against AI harms.
AI is named only inside the customs system, a sector system.

facts.fact: The Ministry of Economy and Finance says the customs directorate, with the Korea Customs Service, launched a project on 4 December 2024 that creates an Enhanced Risk Management tool using AI, with scores indexed to declarations on Sydonia World, full deployment expected in 2026.

MDG.note: No AI model, dataset or AI computing built or hosted in the country is stated.

facts.fact: The Ministry of Economy and Finance says the customs directorate and the Korea Customs Service officially launched on 4 December 2024 a project to modernise the electronic customs clearance system, with a data warehouse and full deployment expected in 2026.
facts.system: Modernisation du systeme de dedouanement electronique (Sydonia World)
